name: greeter
description: A minimal Go HTTP service that returns a personalized JSON greeting for a name supplied on the request, defaulting to "World" when omitted. It is stateless: it stores nothing and has no sign-in. It follows the layout and error conventions of app-factory-kaj/e2e-reference (cmd/<service>/main.go entrypoint, internal/<pkg> for logic, JSON errors as {"error": "message"}). It does not persist, log history, or expose any endpoint beyond the one greeting lookup.
